Our Vision

To see all ethnolinguistic communities in Pakistan flourishing culturally and economically

Our Mission

To empower ethno-linguistic communities of Pakistan to strengthen their linguistic and cultural heritages

Our Core Values

our-objectives/.title: Our Objectives – Forum for Language Initiatives (FLI)
our-objectives/.text: Our Goal “Empowered Local Communities with Diverse and Vibrant Cultural and Linguistic Heritages” Our Objectives Mother-tongue languages are used across socio-cultural and social media domains within targeted minority ethnolinguistic communities. Mother-tongue languages are included in education by the Provincial governments. Children in targeted communities are accessing non-curriculum reading materials in their mother tongue (incl. in digital formats and social media). Businesses supported in promoting local cultural tourism, cultural music and cultural events, and local arts and crafts in targeted minority ethnolinguistic communities. Formalized and effective support from a broad range of organizations and institutions for the promotion of mother tongue language development at local and national levels.
our-objectives/.rawSnippet:
Our  Goal 

“Empowered Local Communities with Diverse and Vibrant Cultural and Linguistic Heritages”

Our Objectives

  • Mother-tongue languages are used across socio-cultural and social media domains within targeted minority ethnolinguistic communities.
  • Mother-tongue languages are included in education by the Provincial governments.
  • Children in targeted communities are accessing non-curriculum reading materials in their mother tongue (incl. in digital formats and social media).
  • Businesses supported in promoting local cultural tourism, cultural music and cultural events, and local arts and crafts in targeted minority ethnolinguistic communities.
  • Formalized and effective support from a broad range of organizations and institutions for the promotion of mother tongue language development at local and national levels.
